Bevel95 golden images

The exact pictures the tests compare against (core/tests/golden), enlarged with hard square pixels. Compare them with real Windows 95 / 2000 screenshots. What to look at closely is listed under "Flagged for your eyes" in docs/theme-spec.md.

Zoom counts real screen pixels, whatever your Windows display scale: at 1× each picture pixel is exactly one screen pixel, which is what a Bevel95 taskbar set to 1× looks like on this screen.
